fullTitle: The Only EKG Book You'll Ever Need
author: Malcolm S. Thaler
libraryStatus: A staged RPSGT V3 source map records a Guild Drive copy and 31 mapped sections for ECG recognition support. Private Drive access remains internal and is not exposed to learners.
apaCitation: Thaler, M. S. (2019). The only EKG book you'll ever need (9th ed.). Wolters Kluwer.
bestFor: ECG waveform morphology, rate determination, sinus rhythms, supraventricular and ventricular arrhythmias, AV block, paced rhythms, QT concepts, and systematic rhythm review for sleep-technologist recognition practice.
authorityBoundary: Supplemental ECG recognition support only. The current AASM Scoring Manual Version 3 cardiac rules govern sleep-study cardiac scoring and reporting, and current facility emergency/cardiac-response policy governs action. PSG ECG is not a diagnostic 12-lead ECG, and this source must not be used as a treatment, medication-dosing, or independent diagnostic authority.
copyrightUse: Use bibliographic metadata, chapter/subsection titles, page locators, and original Sleep Pathways Guild study directions only. Do not reproduce proprietary figures, tracings, tables, questions, or substantial protected prose.
